title: TCP: Speed up checking for unprocessed OOO segments on later passes
description:
Use a hash map (with key and values the same as stored in the list)
to search for unmatched OOO segments on later passes.

This is a large speedup on files that contain many such, i.e. captures
where out of order processing stops due to missing segments such as
iscsi-sci-10TB-data-device available on
https://wiki.wireshark.org/SampleCaptures

AI-Assisted: no
